## Play ECHO

**In your browser — nothing to install:** **https://mb-125.github.io/ECHO/**
Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer.

**Or download it for your computer** (under *Assets* below):

| Your computer | Download | The first time you open it |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `ECHO.Setup.….exe` (installs it) or `ECHO.….exe` (runs without installing) | Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1 and later) | `ECHO-…-arm64.dmg` | Open the file and drag ECHO into Applications. The first time, macOS won't open it: go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to ECHO. (On older macOS: right-click ECHO → **Open**.) |
| **Mac with an Intel chip** | `ECHO-….dmg` | Same as above. |
| **Linux** | `ECHO-….AppImage` (any Linux) or `echo-living-realm_…_amd64.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu) | AppImage: right-click → Properties → allow it to run as a program (or `chmod +x`), then open it. |

The warnings appear because ECHO isn't signed with a paid developer certificate yet. They don't mean anything is wrong with it. The desktop app updates itself when a new version comes out.

**You'll need:** a keyboard and mouse (or a gamepad) and a computer with 3D graphics. Phones and tablets aren't supported yet.

**Your progress:** the browser version and the desktop app each keep their own saves. To move a world between them, use **Export world** on the title screen of one and **Import world** on the other.

**Found a problem?** Press **Esc → Report a problem** in the game, or [report it here](https://github.com/MB-125/ECHO/issues/new/choose).
